firstPlayerRule: The player with the most of their birds in the front row of the flock starts.
officialTieBreak: If tied, the player with the most of their birds in the front two rows starts. If still tied, determine the starting player randomly.
clarifications: Choose the starter after the shuffled initial birds have been placed in the triangular formation. The front row is the row at the arrows; count each player’s own birds.
Players take turns clockwise. On a turn with action dice available, perform a standard action, play a maneuver card or pass. These are sequential turns, not a simultaneous opening.

After a stage ends, score the landing, recover action dice and prepare the next stage. Choose its starter from the new formation using the same front-row, front-two-rows and random tie-break procedure.
The fewer-birds-on-the-board tie-break belongs to the final score after stage three. It does not replace the starting-player tie-break.
These Zoch English rules cover two to four players. Use one included board extension for three players and both for four; use neither for two.
